inspection_scope: Complete data-only review of the film plan, including rhetorical progression, narration coverage, setup boundaries, semantic center, metaphor persistence, token lifecycle, composition continuity, hierarchy, dominant actions, and before/after states.

checks.evidence: Setup s1 uses one coherent inspection world: the same document is fed under a lens, its marks are revealed, its interrupted routes are patched, and it exits. No unrelated physical rule or mechanism is introduced.

Each state of s1 replaces or develops the preceding state: waiting page → page at lens → visible marks → reconnected routes → intact exit. The plan does not retain obsolete mechanisms as new claims arrive.
The document, lens, revealed marks, patches, and Bot all belong to one inspection-and-repair process. The contracts identify one dominant action per beat and no unrelated dominant group.

All four beats retain the same central page, lens, framing, environment, and Bot placement, but the propositions are causally continuous stages of one operation on the same page. This continuity justifies the repeated composition.
No separate continuity tokens are declared. The same hero page persists within one setup because its changing condition is the argument itself; no old set crosses a semantic reset.

The planned geometry is limited to the page, lens, Bot, backboard, work surface, card supports, marks, and patches. Each described element serves action, location, material support, or the visible before/after state.

The four propositions form one uninterrupted inspect–reveal–repair–release progression under the same visual rule. No semantic or evidence-class shift requires an internal reset, and the setup resets at the end.

Every beat names the inspected document as hero and focal target, with one dominant action centered on its interaction with the lens or patches. Bot remains an operator at the page edge rather than a separate competing action region.

The central actions and state changes visibly encode the narration: the page enters the lens, concealed marks become visible, patches reconnect interrupted routes, and the repaired page exits intact. Meaning is not assigned solely to captions or labels.

setup_assessments.evidence: The setup covers the complete narration in order and develops one document through a coherent inspection rule. Its beat contracts provide causal before/after states from entry through revealed findings, repair, and release, with consistent hero, environment, Bot role, and semantic center.

limits: This data-only review can assess planned structure and hierarchy but cannot establish rendered clarity, actual mobile-glance performance, pixel visibility, motion execution, caption legibility, or audio/listening performance.
